Usage & Add-Ons

Monthly allowances renew monthly. Ticket Packs add attendee capacity and announcement emails. Reserved Seating Packs add reserved seats independently. SMS Packs add SMS credits. Each reserved-seat ticket uses both attendee and reserved-seat allowances. Always included: Ticket confirmations, receipts, refunds, reminders, and waitlist notifications.
